# Navigating Through Quicksand

> A resource for building resilience and emotional regulation in students and athletes through evidence-based frameworks and practical coaching strategies.

Navigating Through Quicksand provides guidance on youth development and performance enhancement using the 5 Cs framework (Competence, Confidence, Connection, Character, Caring). The site focuses on resilience training, emotional regulation, and cognitive flexibility for educational and athletic contexts.

## Key Topics

- 5 Cs framework
- Resilience training
- Student performance
- Athlete coaching
- Emotional regulation
- Cognitive flexibility
- Youth development
- Character development
- Competence building
- Confidence enhancement
- Connection and relationships
- Evidence-based frameworks
- Implementation strategies
- Ashley Gustafson

## Resilience Training & Performance

- [Resilience Training Boosts Student Performance](https://navigatingthroughquicksand.com/resilience-training-student-athlete-performance): Guide to resilience training using 5 Cs framework for student and athlete performance gains.
